justification: Policy v1_max36_25pct_cap120 applied in native QUARTERLY units: total sample 100 quarters (300 months). span = min(max(12q, round(100*0.25)), 40q) = 25 quarters. OOS 2020-03-31..2026-03-31 covers COVID, the 2021-23 wage-inflation surge and the 2022 tightening bear market. 25 quarterly observations is a small OOS sample. IS = 75 quarters; the regime models (HMM, Markov-switching) may only be fit on IS rows. No structural-break exclusion applied.
